findings.issue: Three rounds in, the VTC brief has never been opened. The competition page's brief and site-file links are '#' placeholders, probably behind registration. Even so, the as-is workflow states brief content as fact: four A2 boards at 10 MB or less, 'recommended deliverables' (sustainability studies, typical lower, mid and upper plans, two sections, four ground-level perspectives, a QE Park skyline view), site edges, the secondary transit entrance, 'documents are academic, not legal' and 'justified breaches may be rewarded'. These are labelled 'earlier-round read' or credited to the project description. Under the course rule that every result cites its source, none of these has a citable source.
findings.fix: A registered team member downloads the brief PDF and site files before registration closes on 29 Oct. Add the brief as P17-S0x with opened:true, the date and the page numbers. Re-cite every brief-derived item to it, or label each one 'project description, unverified'. Delete the 'earlier-round read' citations.

findings.issue: S68 (academic page) lists LBM, PWC, multi-purpose, SPH and other advanced solvers as excluded from the Free Academic Plan. findings.issue: Delegation is unclear. verdict: Round 3 fixed every BLOCKER and MAJOR from round 2 except the interviews, and the vendor facts I re-read mostly hold. The packet is still not reliable for entrants. After three rounds the VTC brief has never been opened, yet steps 8 and 9 cite the 4 x A2 and 10 MB limits to S01, which does not state them. Other brief content carries no source at all. SimScale is presented as a wind route although LBM and PWC are excluded from both free plans. The site is not georeferenced, so the view-cone check, which could run today, has not. Every 'a person must' action lacks an owner and deadline, and registration closes on 29 Oct. The as-is workflow is still interview n=0. The gate fails until the brief is opened and the action owners are assigned.
